correctness.rationale: The four actual rank-one products sum to I_2, all scalar covariance denominators are positive for 0<eta<1, and Bernoulli independence gives oracle coefficients B_diag=(K+5)/6 and B_off=(K+1)/2. Substitution yields tildeY=I+(K-1)C, with C bounded below in Loewner order by (1/6-1/(4eta))I; the two positive-semidefinite summands of the scaled difference are explicit and the sample (1,1,0,1) attains equality. Thus the exact all-outcome positive-definiteness/semidefiniteness boundaries are K< / <=1+12eta/(3-2eta), and the optimal common semidefinite shift is max(0,(K-1)(1/(4eta)-1/6)-1). The raw sketch is positive definite on this counterevent. Exact Bernoulli covariance sums give raw Frobenius MSE ((1-eta)/eta)(K^2+3)/4 versus corrected MSE ((1-eta)/eta)(K-1)^2/6. The independently constructed audit_checks.py enumerated each of 16 outcomes at several rational eta,K values; finite enumerations corroborate, while the Loewner decomposition proves every real admissible parameter.
